text: Bacthafucup (stylized as BacTHAfucUP, BacTHAfu*UP, or B.T.F.U) is the first studio album by Indian singer and songwriter Karan Aujla, with music produced by Tru Skool. The album was released on 15 September 2021 by Times Music and Speed Records, and the music video for "Chu Gon Do?" was released on 8 July 2021. It consists of 13 tracks and features Harjit Harman, 5 Rivers, Nave Suave, Gurlez Akhtar, and Amaal. The album was streamed more than 95 million times on Spotify. In November 2020, Karan Aujla announced he was working on his debut album and revealed Tru Skool as the producer. In May 2021, he titled the album as BacDAfucUP, and in June 2021, the album's intro was released by Speed Records under its final title, BacTHAfucUP. Aujla released the track listing on 2 July 2021. On 8 July 2021, he released "Chu Gon Do?"'s music video, directed by Rupan Bal. In an interview, Aujla disclosed that each track from the album is of a different kind and that there would be a surprise collaboration. In an interview with Red FM Canada, he stated the album would be out on 30 July 2021, but it was delayed. On 2 September, Aujla released the second intro, "Vibe Check," and stated the album would be about Punjabi folk music, also showing snippets of 3-4 songs. In the intro, he announced the official video for "Click that B Kickin It" would be released on 9 September and that the full album would be out on 15 September. On 9 September 2021, the official video for "Click That B Kickin It" was released, directed by Rupan Bal. The full album was released on all streaming platforms on 15 September 2021. The track "Chu Gon Do" debuted at number 6 on the UK Asian chart published by the Official Charts Company. The album charted at #19 on the Billboard Top Canadian Albums. On 27 September, Karan Aujla became No. 1 Digital Artist in India and No. 37 in the world. All tracks are written by Karan Aujla.
